thread:
support-rotation: FYI customer 'AcmeMaps' reports huge p99 spikes on text-gen since ~02:00 UTC. Backpressure + some 500s. Any quick wins?
infra-bot: alert: model-serving-cluster-east-1: p95=620ms -> 1.2s, p99=1.8s -> 5.6s; GPU memory used per worker +18% in 30m, OOMs flagged on 4 pods. Logs attached to incident-3781.
maria: I'm seeing steady growth in per-request KV cache size for their session IDs. KV growth correlates with long-context replays from client.
nashwin: can you paste the stack trace / OOM log?
maria: paste: ```2026-03-15T02:18:12Z worker-12 ERROR Allocator OOM: failed to allocate 134217728 bytes; arena 3 dirty_pages=2147483648; fragmentation_ratio=0.32; kv_cache_bytes=1.2GB```
priyam: fragmentation ratio 0.32 is suspicious but not catastrophic; KV cache at 1.2GB per worker is the main driver. Is the model variant LlamaX-70b-uint8 pinned?
support-rotation: customer said they pinned to llamaX-70b-8q.ash (long convo sessions).
sre-lead: immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle per-session KV retention (short term config), 2) restart affected pods to compact memory, 3) route their traffic to a dedicated pool with larger VMs, 4) deploy allocator tweaks (jemalloc background defrag / madvise).
ashwin: quick repro steps I used: ```# hit same convo replay loop for 10k tokens
for i in 1..50; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"llamaX-70b-8q.ash","messages":[...long history...]}' https://api.redwood.test/v1/chat/completions; done```
priyam: I can reproduce locally with a short script that appends context without truncation; KV cache keeps growing because we only evict full-prefix entries on LRU but sessions append incrementally.
maria: Proposed short-term change: set kv_cache_max_tokens=1024 per-session and enable kv_ttl_seconds=300 for sessions > 1h. This should cap worker memory.
sre-lead: Agree. Also schedule rolling restart of affected nodes after config roll. Do we risk causing request errors during restart? Keep canary at 5% then ramp.
infra-bot: deploy plan posted: canary to 2 pods in cluster-east-1, config patch kv_cache_max_tokens=1024, kv_ttl_seconds=300, allocator.background_defrag=true.
ashwin: What about allocator tuning? Background defrag + decay_ms lower (jemalloc) reduced fragmentation in our lab by ~15% on long-lived processes. We'll include a safe flag: allocator.defrag_threshold=0.25.
priyam: Also add a guard: if kv_cache_bytes > 900MB then trigger async eviction of oldest prefixes and log event.
maria: I'll prepare the change and a small integration test that simulates incremental append and asserts KV growth < 900MB within 30m.
sre-lead: Action items: maria -> prepare config + test; ashwin -> coordinate canary rollout (ETA 35m); priyam -> add async-evict patch & alert rule; support-rotation -> notify AcmeMaps that we're applying mitigations and ask them to pause heavy replay for 60m.
support-rotation: pinged customer, they approved a short pause and accepted routing to a dedicated pool if needed.
infra-bot: canary started at 2801002600, pods: worker-13, worker-21.
maria: canary logs show kv_cache_bytes peaked at 760MB and then evicted down to 320MB after TTL eviction kicks in. No OOMs so far. p99 for canary dropped from 4.9s -> 1.1s.
sre-lead: Good. Ramp to 30% while monitoring p95/p99 and alloc metrics. If anything spikes, rollback immediately.
priyam: I'll merge the async eviction patch to the staging branch and open PR for review; will include unit tests.
nashwin: Suggest adding a longer-term task: refactor prefix store to use compacted arenas and explicit compaction passes to avoid fragmentation in long-lived processes. Ticket: INF-6212.
support-rotation: I'll keep the customer updated. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: canary ramped to 30% at 2801002880; no new OOMs; continue monitoring for 1h.
sre-lead: Postmortem notes: root cause = unbounded per-session KV retention combined with long-context replay leading to KV growth -> heap fragmentation -> intermittent OOM and p99 latency spikes. Short-term fixes = caps + TTL + allocator defrag. Medium-term = arena compaction + eviction heuristics + safer defaults.
maria: I'll add the rollback playbook to the incident doc and link the reproducer script.
support-rotation: incident cleared for now; customer happy with perf improvements.
